correctedState: `suppressOriginalPrompt` has no reader — that part is true (`grep -ran` repo-wide: prose only). But it is not a gap. Our UserPromptSubmit block message is `decision.reason` alone and never contains the original prompt (`pi-agent.ts:6432` → rendered at `:6567`, `nestor-cloud-agent.ts:277`, `codex-agent.ts:463`), so the flag's only documented effect is already unconditionally in force; a hook setting `true` gets what it asked for. If anything the fork diverges in the opposite direction from the claim — it never echoes, where Claude echoes by default — and no doc sentence guarantees that echo. Separately, the cited anchor `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:241` (`parseHookOutput`) is the dead second executor covered by owner decision `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md` §3 item 5 ("Do not revive hooks-runtime.ts"); it has no production callers and does not parse `decision`/`reason` at all. Any future work on this field belongs in `packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts` (`parseHookCommandOutput`, ~:300-400), not there — and would need a block-message renderer that echoes the prompt first, which this fork does not have.
